title: LADM LA_RRR (abstract base)
description: Abstract base class for Rights, Restrictions, and Responsibilities. Every RRR links a party to a basic administrative unit via an administrative source. Concrete subtypes are LA_Right, LA_Restriction, and LA_Responsibility — identified by the 'rrrType' discriminator.

LA_RRR.description: Abstract RRR mixin — shared properties for all rights, restrictions, and responsibilities

id.description: Globally unique identifier (UUID or URI), OGC API compatible

rrrType.description: Discriminator identifying the concrete RRR subtype

type.description: Specific type of this RRR (LA_RightType, LA_RestrictionType, or LA_ResponsibilityType codelist). Refer to the appropriate codelist scheme for each rrrType.

share.description: Fractional share of this right/restriction/responsibility (e.g. 1/2 for co-ownership). Omit if full interest.

shareCheck.description: Flag indicating the shares across all co-owners have been verified to sum to 1

timeSpec.description: Time specification or duration for this RRR (e.g. lease term, easement period)

party.description: Typed reference to the LA_Party holding this right, restriction, or responsibility [1..1]

unit.description: Typed reference to the LA_BAUnit this RRR applies to [1..1]
